title: Dashboard: Object Gateway Service is not configured after upgrade to helm v1.11.4
body:
* Bug Report

i have cluster, with rook v1.11.3 installed (via helm). I upgraded it to v1.11.4 . All pods are running, and in dashboard there are 2 object gateways
![изображение](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/18194732/232378792-42d8e0ce-0d92-4b99-a12f-a5ee17017273.png)

but in object gateway section there is:
![изображение](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/18194732/232378930-2e8613b7-74a4-4568-9839-6eff461e8952.png)

As i can see, object gateway work properly, because i can see succesfull requests to it in the logs.
I can share logs with you, but i actually don't know, from what module i need to share logs with you

comments.author: participant11
comments.body:
Some observations:
- @participant2 comment above points to https://<redacted-host>/issues/56970 which fixes an issue when trying to connect the dashboard to the rgw via ssl (SSL certificates validate hostnames, not IPs)
- @participant23 states in https://github.com/ceph/ceph/pull/47207#issuecomment-1602626007 that his code change has some similar issues when the rgw runs in k8s while the mgr runs outside
- it does not currently appear to be possible to edit the `service_map` directly (i.e., `ceph service dump`)

Of course I've read the thread. 

But I'm also not naive enough to think people don't implement temporary fixes and decide posting their workaround back to a GitHub issue isn't their top priority.  

Case in point, after pulling our hair out for a while, we've managed to get this to work by enabling hostNetwork on the gateway. Possibly won't work for everyone in this scenario but works fine for us running on our OKD cluster until a proper fix is applied.
